title: Exact random centering and hybrid fluctuation limits for interacting reinforced processes under critical Markov switching
summary: We study two interacting reinforced occupation processes driven by a common two-state Markov environment whose switching probabilities decrease at the same rate as the stochastic-approximation gain. At this critical scale, the environmental motion persists in the first-order limit, which is a telegraph-driven piecewise deterministic Markov process. Consequently, centering at a deterministic equilibrium does not separate the order-one environmental response from the intrinsic square-root fluctuations.
